design_targets.stance: neutral four-foot; small fore/aft offsets, no animation

relative_proportions.normalization: H = target shoulder height; author/export meters, do not normalize the finished animal to a unit cube
relative_proportions.antler_point_count: Unequal stylized margin points; no exact diagnostic count frozen. Preserve basal projection and broad palm rather than maximizing points.
relative_proportions.status: Art-direction starting proportions, not measured fossil data; retain brief tolerance and submit actual morphology to review

shading.strategy: Deliberate mixed faceted/soft normals with broad quiet torso planes and sharper antler edges
shading.double_sided: Do not use double-sided materials to conceal broken winding or unclosed palms

construction: Original custom ring/profile lofts for torso, neck, head and anatomical limb tapers; curved, closed finite-thickness antler meshes with independently editable beam/palm/tine logic. No imported mesh or copied reference pixels.

runtime_plan.note: Maker must probe and record actual tools before geometry. Source dependencies are copied from a pinned canonical version into source/deps and inventoried by relative path and hash.

qa_plan.conditional_gray_view: top if antler planform/clearances remain uncertain
